name: audit-policy-off-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): disables success+failure auditing for the Logon/Logoff and Account Logon categories via auditpol. Vars: none. Idempotent.
script:
auditpol /set /subcategory:'Logon' /success:disable /failure:disable | Out-Null
auditpol /set /subcategory:'Logoff' /success:disable /failure:disable | Out-Null
auditpol /set /subcategory:'Other Logon/Logoff Events' /success:disable /failure:disable | Out-Null
auditpol /set /subcategory:'Credential Validation' /success:disable /failure:disable | Out-Null
